sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Sudhakar Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
Heard Sri Sudhakar Mishra, the learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Jayant Singh Tomar, the learned A.G.A.-I for the State and perused the record.

The instant application has been filed seeking bail for the applicant in Case Crime no. 497 of 2022,
under Sections 363/366, 120 B, 376 D.A. 323, 506, 344 I.P.C. and Section 5/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, registered at Police Station Lalganj, District Raebareli.
The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 02.09.2022 against two named accused persons that (i) Praveen Kumar and (ii) Amit Kumar, lodged on the basis of the application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. filed on 17.08.2022 stating that the informant's minor daughter had gone to fetch some articles from a shop at about 12:30 P.M. on 16.05.2022 but she did not come back.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Upon inquiry, it came to light that the named accused Praveen Kumar had enticed away the informant's daughter.

The F.I.R. further stated that earlier also, Praveen Kumar had enticed away the informant's daughter regarding which Case Crime No. 12/2022 under Section 363,
120-B I.P.C. was lodged in Police Station Lalganj.
Praveen Kumar was enlarged on bail and thereafter he again enticed away the informant's daughter.
In the Statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C, she stated that the applicant was also involved with the named accused Praveen Kumar in taking her away.

Kumar, she stated that she tried to force himself upon her but in response to a categorical question,
she stated that Praveen Kumar did not commit any misdeed with her.
The applicant did not make any other allegations against the applicant in her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C.
However, in a subsequent statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the victim alleged that Praveen Kumar and the applicant both used to rape her.

The learned A.G.A. has filed a counter affidavit annexing therewith a copies of the statement recorded during investigation and a copy of the medico legal examination report of the victim shows that as against the relevant columns containing details of sexual assault, doctor has written "not applicable" and it has been mentioned in the report that there are no marks of any injury on any parts of the victim's body.

Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that earlier also the victim had been enticed away by the named co-accused Praveen Kumar;
regarding which a Case Crime No. 12 of 2022 was lodged; thereafter the named co-accused Praveen Kumar was enlarged on bail; the victim was again taken away by him; that although the victim has mentioned the name of the applicant also in her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she has specifically stated that no misdeed has been committed with her; that the allegation of rape is not supported by the medico legal examination report of the victim and that it is only subsequent that the victim has implicated the applicant in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. and also keeping in view the fact that the applicant has no Criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 19.09.2022, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be enlarged on bail in the aforesaid case.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

sentences.text: In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

. 
(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 22.3.2023 Preeti.
